five_questions: 1. Am I financially able to take on the costs of caring for a dog for 10 to 15 years?
2. Are you prepared to care or arrange for care for a dog every single day?
3. Are you prepared to always be the center of attention?
4. Are you willing and able to accept the training and socialization obligations accompanying a Service Dog?
5. Are you prepared to deal with conflict?

conflicts_with_reference: 5 QUESTIONS: live questions are self-assessment questions (finances for 10–15 yrs, daily care, being the centre of attention, training/socialisation obligations, dealing with conflict) explicitly 'not meant to be answered with a simple yes or no' and sourced from anythingpawsable.com. Reference replaces them with 5 yes/no eligibility questions (honorable discharge, physical/psychological disability, participate in training, safe home, commitment) and 'If you answered Yes ... you may be eligible' — none of these appear on the live site.

ELIGIBILITY WORDING: reference 'military veteran with an honorable discharge' and 'physical or psychological disability' — live site never mentions discharge status; live says 'Veteran or Family Member of a Veteran considering a Service K9', 'HK9 reserves the right to deny any application', and 'does not provide funding ... for Veterans with a dog OUTSIDE of our network of breeders'.

PROGRAM STEPS: reference = 4 steps (Application & Assessment → Rigorous Training → Precision Matching → Team Placement) plus 'What to Expect' (Application Review, Interview & Assessment, Team Training). Live = Step One read 5 Questions; Step Two online screening application ('NOT the full application'); Step Three phone conversation & baseline assessment; Step Four full application emailed (medical info, living conditions, history); Step Five if selected, search for the 'right fit' K9; then training (service training not before 7 months old; HK9 pays K9 medical costs + food/kennel for 1st year; veteran training covers commands, de-escalation, conflict resolution, ADA; final practical exam → graduation; lifetime commitment, re-training available). Reference orders training before matching; live matches first.

NATIONWIDE CLAIM: reference says 'Nationwide Reach', 'Serving disabled U.S. veterans nationwide', 'providers across the country'. Live site makes no nationwide claim; evidence points regional: 'Distributed across Missouri and surrounding states', 'Not local to the 4 state area? add $5 shipping', obedience training 'Serving Joplin, Webb City, Carthage, Pittsburg & Surrounding Areas', training participation 'based on the location of the Veteran'.

TESTIMONIALS: reference has three quotes attributed to 'USMC Veteran, Paired in 2022', 'Army Veteran, Paired in 2023', 'Navy Veteran, Paired in 2021' — none exist on the live site. Live /success/ is an unpopulated placeholder ('Success Story / Read More' ×3 → sample page with 'Snippet About the breeder'). The only genuine quote is Madison Stratton's on Meet the Team ('Its truly night and day compared to where I was to where I am now...').

FOUNDING YEAR: reference 'Est. 2015' is SUPPORTED by live (Ted Donaldson bio 'since its founding in 2015'; EIN 47-xxxxxxx; 'ten years' on 2026 obedience page) — no conflict, but the fact is buried in a bio.

STATS: reference has no numeric stats; live has '$18,000' current cost to train and place a K9 (two pages), '30,000-follower' book review account, 'over 20 years working with dogs' (board president), '3 of each $9 ticket'. Reference omits $18,000.

PHONE/EMAIL/HOURS: reference 800-913-6189 and info@heartlandk9s.org match live. Reference omits 417-312-7484 (live 'Director cell', footer, donate, all BarKode records) and director@/development@ emails. Reference adds 'Mon–Fri' / 'Monday – Friday' to hours — live never states days.
ADDRESS/EIN: reference has no street address, no EIN, no Candid seal; live footer/contact/donate use 12651 Gateway Dr, Neosho MO 64850 and EIN 47-4991572.

BARKODE: reference describes 'a specialized BarKode patch', 'digital certification and emergency contact patch', 'Every Heartland K9 is equipped', 'Proprietary System'. Live: 'unique team number and QR code documented in our secure database'; 'voluntary validation service'; scan shows photo, team ID, trained tasks, emergency contact, vet info, HK9 contact; 'free service only for HK9-trained teams; other providers' teams only after application, evaluation, any additional training and annual fee'; branded 'BarKode ©' with SM logo. Live also states the program is 'new'/'now available' and asks for donations to it.

K9 PROVIDERS: reference 'elite K9 providers and trainers across the country ... View Our Providers'. Live /the-service-k9-program/ lists acceptance criteria (AKC registered, breed-matched, temperament exam, traceable history, 10 weeks–16 months, pre-birth arrangements possible) and rejections (strays, non-AKC, older than 14 months, undocumented, pets) — internal live inconsistency 16 vs 14 months. No provider directory exists; /back-the-pack/ is a sponsor logo wall.

NAVIGATION: reference nav About/Program/Veterans/BarKode/Stories/Get Involved/Contact/Donate Now; live nav DONATE/5 QUESTIONS/APPLICATION/ADA FAQs/CONTACT/PARTNER WITH US/PHOTOS/VOLUNTEER/EVENTS/CAMPAIGNS. Live has no About page; team/teams-in-training/highlighted team/BarKode/gear/program pages are reachable only from homepage buttons. Reference links Donate/Campaigns/Providers/ADA FAQs/Start Application/View Campaigns to the bare live root URL.

CONTACT FORM: reference form fields First Name, Last Name, Email Address, Subject (Veteran Application Inquiry / Donation Inquiry / Volunteer / Campaign / K9 Provider Partnership / Other), Message. Live contact & application forms are BROKEN: '[ccf_form id="2132"]' and '[ccf_form id="2156"]' print as literal text (Custom Contact Forms plugin inactive); live field lists are unknown.

MISSION COPY: reference 'Driven by a single goal...' and 'We use proven canine training strategies...' match live homepage HOW IT WORKS; reference 'Dedicated to Derron & Rosie' matches live. Reference logo path /heartland-k9s-logo.png vs live Concept-1-rocker-outlined-2.png.
VOLUNTEER: live mentions the 'Paws for Training' temporary-home program and facility visits; reference volunteer copy is generic (events, administration, spreading the word).

LIVE INTERNAL CONFLICTS worth resolving in the rebuild: Donate page says 'Donate online with PayPal' (hosted button still present) while homepage/footer push Zeffy; Heartland Gear says 'Your donation will go through paypal' but the button goes to linksinkllc.com; thank-you page mailing address (PO Box 101 Saginaw) differs from current (12651 Gateway Dr Neosho); 'Paws for Giving' stickers 'available by 2023'; Board President spelled Flemming/Fleming; Willow is described as 'in training' on Meet the Team but has a full BarKode record; Riley record lacks the 'Any questions' line; Caddie is both 'Service K9 In Training' record and highlighted team.

pages.title: BarKode – A Service of Heartland Canines for Veterans
headings: h5: BarKode is a unique service provided by Heartland Canines For Veterans to facilitate Service K9 Teams public access and ensure that in an emergency these uniquely trained Canines are not separated from their handler. This voluntary validation service provides verification for First Responders so Service K9s are provided the appropriate care and concern. BarKode can also remove ambiguity for businesses regarding Service K9 Team public access regarding the relevant aspects of the Americans With Disabilities Act (ADA).

h5: Heartland Canines For Veterans trained teams are assigned a unique team number and QR code which is documented in our secure database. By scanning the BarKode, a picture of the Service K9 is displayed along with information to identify the team and the tasks the canine is trained to perform along with emergency contact and pertinent veterinarian information. Heartland Canines For Veterans contact information is also displayed.

h5: BarKode is a free service only for Heartland Canines For Veterans trained Service K9 Teams. Service K9 Teams trained by other providers may be provided access to this service only after application, evaluation, any additional training and annual fee.
h5: Contact Heartland K9s for more information at (800) 913-6189 or director@heartlandk9s.org.
pages.disposition: MIGRATE program page; note '©'/SM branding and fee wording for non-HK9 teams
